---
title: "Python"
---

The code blocks on this page are illustrative and are not executed when the
site is built: every example needs the cache or the network. The verified
examples, run as doctests, are on the
[developer docs](https://legistlan.github.io/scjn/dev/).

Every reader reads only the cache and raises `AssetNotCached` rather than
downloading; only `download_*_assets` and `scjn download` (see
[Command line](cli.qmd)) talk to the network.

## `scjn-leyes`

```python
import scjn

scjn.download_scjn_leyes_assets(["lfca"])        # network: put the assets on disk
scjn.local_slugs()                               # the slugs already on disk

scjn.download_scjn_leyes_index()                 # the release's index
scjn.download_scjn_leyes_corpus("lfca")          # one law's corpus
scjn.download_scjn_leyes_catalog()               # the catalogue of laws

scjn.markdown_de_snapshot("lfca", "<snapshot file name>")
scjn.markdown_de_snapshot("lfca", "<snapshot file name>", outline=False)

for law in scjn.iter_current_federal_laws(["lfca"]):
    ...                                          # the current text of each law
```

- `download_scjn_leyes_index`, `download_scjn_leyes_corpus` and
  `download_scjn_leyes_catalog` read the cached index, one law's tarball and the
  catalogue (which includes the SCJN's own `materia`, `vigencia` and `resumen`).
- `markdown_de_snapshot` returns one reform's Markdown, with the
  [outline markers](outline.qmd) by default; `outline=False` returns the
  same text without them, byte for byte.
- `iter_current_federal_laws` yields the current text of each law, one tarball
  open at a time.
- `AssetNotCached` is raised for whatever is not on disk yet.

## The id-keyed releases

`scjn-reglamentos`, `scjn-lineamientos` and `scjn-tratados` have the same
functions with `reglamentos`, `lineamientos` or `tratados` in the name, keyed by
`id_ordenamiento` rather than by slug:

```python
scjn.download_scjn_reglamentos_assets(["104906"])
scjn.local_reglamentos_ids()
scjn.download_scjn_reglamentos_index()
scjn.download_scjn_reglamentos_corpus("104906")

for reglamento in scjn.iter_current_reglamentos():
    ...
```

`download_scjn_lineamientos_*`, `download_scjn_tratados_*`,
`local_lineamientos_ids`, `local_tratados_ids`, `iter_current_lineamientos` and
`iter_current_tratados` follow the same pattern. An instrument with no
consolidated text raises `SinTextoEnSCJN`.

## What only `leyes` has

Only `scjn-leyes` has an `abrev` (the release's slug and asset name, never
re-derived), an `actualizado` (`actualizado_scjn`, `actualizado_dof`), an
`indice.json` and DOF linking. "Reform N" of a law is the SCJN reform table's
chronological order. Linking a reform to its DOF `codNota` happens one layer up,
in `nota2md`: a `codNota` is a DOF concept, and `scjn` imports no sibling
package.
